about_the_game:
The train has arrived, and with it comes a wave of curious cats.

In Cat Isle a cozy pixel art management game, you’ll create a thriving island where adorable cats come to live, eat, and play.

Build restaurants and configure their recipes, then decorate and expand your town with new shops, parks, and homes. Every detail matters as you figure out your feline residents needs and make the island feel alive. Watch them wander the streets, enjoy a hot bowl of ramen, mingle with the other cats on the island, or spend a quiet afternoon fishing by the water.

As your island grows, you’ll unlock more ways to keep your cats happy whether it’s new decorations, leisure spots, or simply giving them plenty of cozy corners to nap in. With every upgrade, your once sleepy station town will transform into a bustling, cat filled paradise.

Minimum:
